blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO — Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs won their 11th straight game, rolling past the Golden State Warriors 123-85 Friday night to remain unbeaten in NBA Cup play. Golden State’s only double-figure scorers were L.J. Cryer with 20 points and Charles Bassey with 11. READ: NBA: Wembanyama ‘where I want to be’ after another spectacular night The Warriors are without Stephen Curry, who is sidelined at least two weeks with a right oblique tear suffered in a 115-108 loss in Houston on Wednesday.
